basic_details.job_title: DLSA Jalore Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 26 Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Legal Services Authority Jalore (DLSA Jalore) has announced 26 vacancies for the Para Legal Volunteer post on a temporary and honorary basis. Eligible applicants can submit their offline application by hand to the Office of the District Legal Services Authority, Jalore or concerned Taluka Legal Services Committee on or before 5 November 2026, starting from 16 October 2026. Candidates applying for the position must have passed the Secondary (10th) examination and meet the specified eligibility conditions. The selected candidates will receive an honorarium as per NALSA / RSLSA guideline

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must submit their application in the prescribed format provided in the notification. Completed applications along with all required self-attested documents must be submitted in person at the office of the authority or concerned Taluka Legal Services Committee of Jalore, Bhinmal, Raniwada, Sanchore, or Ahor.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Must have passed the Secondary (10th) examination from the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education. Must be able to read and write Devanagari script fluently and possess good communication and working knowledge. Applicants must be at least 21 years of age or above (Minimum 21 years). The recruitment prioritizes candidates from specific backgrounds, including: Students and scholars of social science at the undergraduate or postgraduate level. Anganwadi workers / saathi. Volunteers from Nehru Yuva Kendra, social workers, and livelihood workers. Law students (provided they are not enrolled for legal practice). Members of non-political organizations and non-governmental organizations operating with a spirit of public service, as well as club members. Members of NGO women's groups and self-help groups. Educated prisoners with good behavior who have served a long sentence. Any other person deemed competent by the District Legal Services Authority or Taluka Legal Services Committee. content_sections.heading: DLSA Jalore Para Legal Volunteer Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected Para Legal Volunteers ( अधिकार मित्र ) will perform the following duties in their villages, wards, and neighborhoods: Educate citizens on living a dignified life and make them aware of their constitutional and legal rights and duties. Assist citizens in resolving disputes and problems by connecting them with legal services authorities or mediation centres. Assist the DLSA or Taluka Legal Services Committee in organizing legal awareness camps. Provide information on ongoing state and central legal aid schemes, the National Legal Services Authority, and the High Court Legal Services Committee, and ensure free legal services reach eligible persons. Encourage pre-litigation settlement of disputes through DLSA or Taluka Legal Services Committees without any court fee or expenses, explaining that lok adalats can settle matters amicably without cost. Guide citizens on utility services (transport, post, electricity, water, sanitation, banking, housing, and land records) for settlement through permanent lok adalats without court fees. Disseminate information regarding welfare schemes implemented by the central and state governments at prominent public places. Actively support legal aid clinics established in their area. Make vulnerable sections of society aware of their rights and assist victims of crime with compensation under Section 357-A / 396 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. Visit jails, lock-ups, observation homes, and de-addiction hospitals upon authorization to apprise inmates of their legal rights. Provide information regarding pre-litigation counseling, alternate dispute resolution, and lok adalats. Submit a monthly report or report of activities to the chairperson of the DLSA or Taluka Legal Services Committee by the 2nd of the following month.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of the following documents with their application: Verified copy of Secondary (10th) marksheet or certificate for proof of date of birth. Verified copy of educational qualification certificates. Latest original character certificate not older than 6 months issued by a respectable person. Self-attested passport-size photograph pasted on the application form (do not staple). Verified copy of Bonafide Resident Certificate. Document supporting local residency in the village or ward where application is made (Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, Voter ID Card, Bonafide Resident Certificate, or equivalent proof). Self-declaration affidavit stating that no criminal case is pending against the applicant.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received will be scrutinized. Eligible candidates will be called for an interview. Successful candidates in the interview will undergo training as Para Legal Volunteers.

faq.question: Q1. What is DLSA Jalore Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DLSA Jalore has invited offline applications to fill 26 Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) vacancies on a temporary and honorary basis across Jalore, Bhinmal, Raniwada, Sanchore, and Ahor.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 26 vacancies distributed across Jalore (6), Bhinmal (6), Sanchore (6), Raniwada (4), and Ahor (4).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form to the DLSA Jalore office or Taluka Legal Services Committee is 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed the Secondary (10th) examination from the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education and be able to read and write Devanagari script.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be a minimum of 21 years of age or above.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for DLSA Jalore Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the application form attached to the notification, attach self-attested documents, and submit it by hand at the DLSA Jalore office or concerned Taluka Legal Services Committee office by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection involves scrutiny of applications, an interview of eligible candidates, and subsequent training for successful candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the PLV position is purely temporary and honorary, and the appointment does not constitute a regular government job or civil service appointment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary or honorarium provided?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive a fixed honorarium or allowance as per NALSA and RSLSA guidelines, with no regular salary, wages, or extra package.
